Who We Are Scaling the world’s businesses with tech At Lapis Technologies , we believe technology should not just be powerful, it should be purposeful. Founded in 2008 by T.V. What started as a vision has grown into a trusted brand across South India, empowering businesses with advanced solutions that work seamlessly behind the scenes. With over 17+ years of expertise, we’ve become a value-added distributor that does more than just supply products. From Networking and Cybersecurity to Video Surveillance, Access Control, PA Systems, Fire Safety, Display, Pro AV, and Printing Products, we help organizations choose the right technologies for their needs. We proudly partner with some of the world’s leading technology brands like LG, Bosch, Netgear, Fortinet, Legrand and many more… Whether it’s a high-impact video wall for a corporate boardroom, a robust cybersecurity system for a bank, or a smart surveillance setup for a school. Our team ensures that every solution is well-suited, installed, and supported with care. Headquartered in Hyderabad, and with offices in Vijayawada and Visakhapatnam, we’re close to our customers and even closer to their challenges. Our job doesn’t end with delivery. Securing the Future. Advanced Networking & Cybersecurity – A Shield for Your Digital Success In today’s digital world, staying connected is not just a luxury; it’s a necessity. At Lapis Technologies , we offer powerful and reliable Networking & Cybersecurity solutions that help you build strong networks and protect what matters most, your data. Over the years, we’ve supported startups, large enterprises, educational institutions, retail spaces, and even homes in setting up fast, secure, and scalable digital infrastructure. Whether you’re building a smart office, upgrading your Wi-Fi, or safeguarding a business network, we’re here to make it simple and stress-free. Access Points & Base Stations : Say goodbye to dead zones and poor connectivity. Our access points and base stations offer smooth, high-speed Wi-Fi coverage across large and small spaces, ideal for offices, campuses, and even homes with multiple users. Adapters & Bridge : Plug-and-play tools that help you connect new devices, expand existing setups, or bridge different networks, all without needing a technician. Easy to install and reliable in performance. Cables & Extenders : When distance becomes a challenge, our high-quality cables and extenders ensure your network signal remains strong and steady, even across multiple floors or wide areas.
